ok. i restarted. its back to where it was pre-edit. still figure out why that happened, 

the sequence of events was 

select faces (like 60 of them) -> detach faces -> it popped up 4 concave faces -> i hit split quads -> i did not like the quad split it made -> i did undo -> broken
resolution: Reconstructed the detach, move, concavity Split Quads, Undo sequence and fixed both durable logical-vertex repartitioning and synchronous Outliner journal handoff; added Zig and TS regressions and built the editor.
